title: Concentrated solutions to fractional Schrödinger-Poisson system with non-homogeneous potentials
summary: This paper mainly investigates several limit properties of normalized solutions for the fractional Schrödinger-Poisson system, including existence, concentration behaviors and local uniqueness. It is worth noting that our results on the existence and asymptotic behaviors of normalized solutions are obtained in a doubly nonlocal setting and without assuming homogeneity of the potential, which generalize the results in \cite{GDCDS} in several aspects and improve our previous work in \cite{LIUYANG}.
